hypotheses.name: naive-gate-separates
hypotheses.statement: The 0.2 vocabulary-overlap gate proposed in method-generality-note-v0 refuses the unrelated pair.
hypotheses.check: naive overlap coefficient = 0.2567 > 0.2: the gate would ADMIT the pair. Falsified.

hypotheses.name: stopword-gate-separates
hypotheses.statement: Filtering function words before computing overlap brings the unrelated pair below the gate.
hypotheses.check: content-word overlap = 0.2092, still above 0.2 (generic verbs and homographs: line, return, check). Falsified.

hypotheses.name: term-head-gate-separates
hypotheses.statement: The intersection of the top-25 content-word heads discriminates: the unrelated pair has a disjoint head; related pairs overlap.
hypotheses.check: cookbook vs irs: 0/25 = 0.00. Calibration: BP001 vs TrustBase 3/25 = 0.12 (weak, real); BBB vs Bigelow 14/25 = 0.56 (strong). Monotone, ordered, and correct on all three.

hypotheses.name: method-refuses-honestly
hypotheses.statement: On the unrelated pair the method reports 'no common term' and declines to read, instead of manufacturing a relation.
hypotheses.check: heads disjoint, no shared key phrases, no shared named entities: the alignment machinery has no surface to align. The refusal is the correct null reading.

supersedes.replacement: top-25 content-word head intersection, refuse below 0.08
supersedes.reason: both vocabulary-overlap variants admit a cookbook/tax-form pair; only the head intersection refuses it
